async def run(items):
    a = [await load()]
    b = [*(await load())]
    c = [item for item in await load() if item.active]
    d = [
        item
        for item in await load()
        if item.active
        if item.valid
        if item.ready
        if item.enabled
        if item.visible
    ]
    e = [item async for item in source()]
    f = [await save(item) async for item in source()]
    g = [
        await save(item)
        for item in items
        if item.active
        if item.valid
        if item.ready
        if item.enabled
        if item.visible
    ]
    return a, b, c, d, e, f, g
